name: Whatsmarchy
author: boyoyooo
description: WhatsApp notifications in the Omarchy bar, powered by wacli. The bar shows who is waiting and how many messages — never the message text. Click for previews, image thumbnails, voice-note playback, optional local transcription, and a quick text reply.

barWidget.description: WhatsApp unread senders and counts, with a preview panel and quick reply (requires wacli)

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the local wacli database is checked for new messages. Nothing is fetched from WhatsApp — that is wacli sync's job.

schema.label: Display label
schema.description: Optional text shown in the panel header, useful if you run more than one WhatsApp account.

schema.label: What the bar shows
schema.description: Message text is never shown in the bar, at any setting.

schema.label: Include WhatsApp Channels
schema.description: Off by default: channels are usually broadcast noise rather than messages addressed to you.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: "Sender and preview" puts message text on screen, which anyone nearby can read.

schema.label: Hide the widget when there is nothing new
